nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What environmental issues are linked to the production of ultra-processed foods?
nodes.answer: The production of ultra-processed foods contributes to environmental problems such as biodiversity losses associated with commodity ingredient production and plastic packaging waste.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Sustainable packaging alternatives_qna_001
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What was the closing question for respondents in the company version of the questionnaire?
nodes.answer: Respondents were asked about their willingness to implement green practices in the future, with response options being "yes" or "no".

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Sustainable supply chains|Sustainable packaging alternatives_qna_002
nodes.label: Factual
nodes.question: What are some sustainable options consumers are willing to pay more for when it comes to plastics packaging?
nodes.answer: Consumers are willing to pay more for sustainable options such as bioplastics and recycled plastics, according to studies by Herrmann et al., 2022 and Rein and Schmid, 2020.
